task:
Refactor: collect commander's internal helper functions in lib/utils.js

The small helper functions are scattered over several modules. Please move them into one new module, `lib/utils.js`, and export each one by name from there:

- `camelcase` and `splitOptionFlags` (currently in `lib/option.js`)
- `humanReadableArgName` (currently in `lib/argument.js`)
- `editDistance` and `suggestSimilar` (currently in `lib/suggestSimilar.js`)

Then delete `lib/suggestSimilar.js`, and update every importer (`lib/command.js`, `lib/help.js`, `lib/option.js`, `lib/argument.js`, and any tests) to import the helpers from `./utils.js`. Do not leave the helpers defined or re-exported in their old modules.

This is a pure refactor: the public API exported from `index.js` must not change, behavior must not change, and `npm test` must keep passing.
